course.title: Urban Governance
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Suppose Mr. X works in a government office. He noticed that the government system is not functioning well in the office. More specifically the new appointment procedure of manpower hampered seriously after maintaining different actors of governance processes. Then he is very interested to solve the problem but now his position is in the last tier of citizen participation ladder. Given the above situation, address the following two questions.
Why the good governance is necessary for the office? “Governance: Goes beyond the Government”- how can you relate it with the appointment procedure of the office?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
